props.name: children
props.description: Composed trigger and content primitives.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: closable
props.description:
Whether to show the corner close button inside the content. Its accessible label comes from
the `close` translation.

props.name: closeIcon
props.description: Name of the icon shown in the corner close button.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description:
Whether pressing Escape dismisses the overlay. When `false`, Escape fires `onClosePrevented`
instead.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description:
Whether clicking or focusing outside dismisses the overlay. When `false`, outside interaction
fires `onClosePrevented` instead.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is not set.

props.name: defaultSnapPoint
props.description:
Snap point the drawer opens at when `snapPoint` is not set. The drawer returns to it after
each close.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description:
Element (or accessor resolving to one) that receives focus after the shell closes, or
`false` to skip the close-time focus restore. Defaults to the trigger, then the element
focused when the shell opened. An accessor that returns `undefined` restores no focus. Only
applies while `modal` is `true`.
examples:
import { Button, Dialog } from 'moraine'

<Dialog finalFocus={() => document.getElementById('search') ?? undefined}>
  <Dialog.Trigger as={Button}>Open</Dialog.Trigger>
  <Dialog.Content title="Settings">Preferences</Dialog.Content>
</Dialog>

props.name: handle
props.description:
Whether to render the decorative grab handle. It is only rendered when `side` is `top` or
`bottom`.

props.name: id
props.description:
Unique identifier used to derive the content id, which becomes `<id>-content`. Generated
when omitted.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description:
Element (or accessor resolving to one) that receives focus when the shell opens, or `false`
to skip the open-time focus move. Defaults to the first focusable element inside the
content, preferring an `[autofocus]` or `[data-autofocus]` descendant, and to the content
itself when opened by touch. An accessor that returns `undefined` falls back to the default.
Only applies while `modal` is `true`.
examples:
import { Button, Dialog } from 'moraine'
import { createSignal } from 'solid-js'

const [input, setInput] = createSignal<HTMLInputElement>()

<Dialog initialFocus={() => input()}>
  <Dialog.Trigger as={Button}>Rename</Dialog.Trigger>
  <Dialog.Content title="Rename">
    <input ref={setInput} />
  </Dialog.Content>
</Dialog>

props.name: modal
props.description:
Whether the surface contains focus, restores focus on close, hides outside content from
assistive technology, and prevents the native default action of outside pointer events.
Outside pointer dismissal is controlled by `closeOnOutsideClick`.
Escape dismissal is controlled by `closeOnEscape`. When `false`, focus is neither trapped,
moved on open nor restored on close, so `initialFocus` and `finalFocus` have no effect.

props.name: mount
props.description:
DOM node that `BaseDialog.Portal`, and the content of `Dialog`, `Sheet` and `Drawer`, render into,
for example a container element or a shadow root. A `mount` on `BaseDialog.Portal` takes
precedence. Defaults to the `body` of the trigger's document.
examples:
import { Button, Dialog } from 'moraine'

const container = document.getElementById('overlay-root') ?? document.body

<Dialog mount={container}>
  <Dialog.Trigger as={Button}>Open</Dialog.Trigger>
  <Dialog.Content title="Settings">Preferences</Dialog.Content>
</Dialog>

props.name: onClosePrevented
props.description:
Called with no arguments when Escape (`closeOnEscape` is `false`) or an outside interaction
(`closeOnOutsideClick` is `false`) tried to close the overlay and was blocked.

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description:
Called once after a close has finished: the exit motion is over and the content is
unmounted. With `transition` set to `false` there is no motion to wait for. It is not called
when the content is removed while still open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Called with the next open state when the trigger, a close part, Escape or an outside press
requests a change. It is not called when `open` is changed from outside, and it does not
apply the change itself when `open` is controlled: update `open` in the handler.
examples:
import { Button, Dialog } from 'moraine'
import { createSignal } from 'solid-js'

const [open, setOpen] = createSignal(false)

<Dialog open={open()} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  <Dialog.Trigger as={Button}>Open</Dialog.Trigger>
  <Dialog.Content title="Settings">Preferences</Dialog.Content>
</Dialog>

props.name: onSnapPointChange
props.description:
Called with the new active snap point when a swipe settles on a different one, and with the
default point after the drawer has finished closing, if the active point differed. `null`
means fully open.
examples:
import { Button, Drawer } from 'moraine'
import type { DrawerT } from 'moraine'
import { createSignal } from 'solid-js'

const [snapPoint, setSnapPoint] = createSignal<DrawerT.SnapPoint | null>(0.4)

<Drawer snapPoints={[0.4, 1]} snapPoint={snapPoint()} onSnapPointChange={setSnapPoint}>
  <Drawer.Trigger as={Button}>Open</Drawer.Trigger>
  <Drawer.Content title="Details">Drawer content</Drawer.Content>
</Drawer>

props.name: open
props.description:
Controlled open state. Leave it `undefined` to manage state internally (see `defaultOpen`);
when set, update it from `onOpenChange`.

props.name: overlay
props.description:
Whether to render the styled backdrop behind the content. When `false` the content is shown
without a backdrop; outside presses still follow `closeOnOutsideClick`.

props.name: preventScroll
props.description:
Whether body scroll should be locked while the shell is present. Defaults to the value of
`modal`: modal shells lock scroll, non-modal shells do not unless set.

props.name: side
props.description:
Viewport edge the drawer is attached to and slides in from. Swiping toward that edge dismisses
it, and only `top` and `bottom` drawers render the grab handle.

props.name: snapPoint
props.description:
Controlled active snap point, normally one of the `snapPoints` entries. `null` selects the
fully open position and `undefined` leaves the state uncontrolled (see `defaultSnapPoint`). Update it
from `onSnapPointChange`.

props.name: snapPoints
props.description:
Visible heights the drawer can rest at, measured from the edge it opens from, in any order.
Each is a number (`<= 1` is a fraction of the viewport height, `> 1` is pixels) or a `px` or
`rem` string; heights are clamped to the drawer and the viewport. Releasing a swipe settles
on the closest point (projected by the swipe velocity), and dragging past the lowest point
dismisses the drawer. Only honored when `side` is `top` or `bottom`.
examples:
import { Button, Drawer } from 'moraine'

<Drawer snapPoints={[0.4, '24rem', 1]}>
  <Drawer.Trigger as={Button}>Open</Drawer.Trigger>
  <Drawer.Content title="Details">Drawer content</Drawer.Content>
</Drawer>

props.name: snapToSequentialPoints
props.description:
Whether a fast flick settles on the next adjacent snap point (or dismisses past the lowest
one) instead of projecting the swipe velocity onto the closest point.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: transition
props.description:
Whether enter and exit transition animations play. When `false`, the content and overlay
mount and unmount without waiting for an animation to end. The value is read when content
registers, so changes take effect the next time content mounts.

props.name: translations
props.description:
Overrides for the built-in strings of this drawer, merged over the `MoraineProvider` locale.
Only `close` is used here: the accessible label of the corner close button.
examples:
import { Button, Drawer } from 'moraine'

<Drawer translations={{ close: 'Fermer' }}>
  <Drawer.Trigger as={Button}>Open</Drawer.Trigger>
  <Drawer.Content title="Réglages">Préférences</Drawer.Content>
</Drawer>

Composable drawer parts or render function receiving close action.
A render function must declare its parameter, even when unused. A zero-argument
function is called as an accessor and is not mounted as a component.

props.name: description
props.description:
Description rendered below the title in the generated header, and referenced by
`aria-describedby`. Ignored when the children include an explicit `Drawer.Header`.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: title
props.description:
Title rendered in a generated header, and used as the accessible name of the drawer
(`aria-labelledby`, unless `aria-label` is set). Ignored when the children include an
explicit `Drawer.Header`.
